title: Great connecting.

lines.text: Did anyone get back to Miriam about Friday?
I personalized all the conference follow-ups.
What did you and Miriam talk about?
Staying connected. And the value of being in the room.
She needs a keyboard player for the Friday session.
Her message is in the relationship tracker.
What does it say?
Great to meet you. Is your keyboard player available on Friday?
Keys said she might be. I wrote it on the programme.
I can add that to the tracker.
Could we ask her first?
I have. She can do it after two. She said I can pass her email on.
The current draft says we look forward to exploring opportunities for collaboration.
We could say after two.
After two. And her email address.
That should do it.
Would you like me to include a summary of our capabilities?
She heard us play.
Of course.
Thank you for following up.
I nearly sent the other version.
This one gives her something to book.

ending.heading: Re: Friday session
lines: She’s happy for me to share her email.
ending.detail: A specific reply replaces the follow-up template.

performance: Sincere, restrained; preserve original cast voices. New takes require listening review.
